name: Rounds
summary: Resident safety, medication workflows, family-update previews, records, and supervised restart.
description: Rounds uses the existing Convex deployment for resident lookup, medication safety, review-only family-update previews, administration logging, and local MCP restart.

tools.name: find_resident
tools.title: Find resident
tools.description: Look up a nursing-home resident by name and return room, allergies, fall risk, and code status. Use when staff ask for a resident profile or safety details.

tools.name: get_due_meds
tools.title: Get due medications
tools.description: List medications due during the current hour, optionally for one resident. Use when staff ask what is due now or what a named resident needs this hour.

tools.name: check_med_administration
tools.title: Check medication administration
tools.description: Check the Five Rights plus allergy and duplicate-dose safeguards without recording a dose. Use immediately before administration; a verified result supplies arguments for log_med_administration.

tools.name: draft_family_update
tools.title: Draft family update
tools.description: Generate review-only family-update text from resident data after approval. Use when staff want a draft to review; this tool does not send or save a message.

root.html:
Generate family updatePreview only

No email, SMS, or other message is sent. This creates reviewable text only.

tools.name: log_med_administration
tools.title: Log medication administration
tools.description: Commit a previously checked medication dose as given. Use only after check_med_administration returns verified values and the staff member approves the record.

root.html:
Record medication administrationFive Rights

Cancel and repeat the safety check if any verified value is wrong.

tools.name: restart_mcp_server
tools.title: Restart MCP server
tools.description: Restart the local Rounds MCP process. Use only when the user explicitly asks to refresh or restart the integration.

root.html:
Restart local serviceRounds

The local connection will briefly close. Resident and medication records are unchanged.
